rows.label: giant squid
rows.hook: is a legendary deep-sea monster with enormous eyes, long thought to be a myth of sailors

rows.label: whale shark
rows.hook: is the largest living animal of its kind, a gentle spotted giant that filters plankton

rows.label: great white shark
rows.hook: is the famous apex predator of the Jaws films, feared as the ocean's top hunter

rows.label: narwhal
rows.description: medium-sized toothed whale that lives year-round in the Arctic
rows.hook: is the Arctic 'unicorn of the sea' with a long spiralled tusk sprouting from its head

rows.label: Barnacle
rows.hook: is a hard-shelled creature that glues itself to rocks, ship hulls and piers

rows.label: Portuguese man o' war
rows.hook: is a floating colony with a sail-like gas bladder and painfully stinging tentacles

rows.label: colossal squid
rows.hook: is the heaviest known invertebrate, a deep Antarctic giant with rotating hooks on its arms

rows.label: blue-ringed octopus
rows.hook: is a tiny, brightly marked sea creature carrying a potentially deadly venom

rows.label: walrus
rows.hook: is a tusked Arctic giant that hauls itself onto ice floes and sports a bristly moustache

rows.label: basking shark
rows.hook: is the second-largest fish in the sea, cruising with its huge mouth open to filter plankton

rows.label: leopard seal
rows.hook: is a spotted Antarctic predator that hunts penguins

rows.label: sea otter
rows.hook: floats on its back, cracks shellfish open with a rock and holds paws with its friends

rows.label: humpback whale
rows.hook: is famous for its haunting, complex songs and for leaping clear out of the water

rows.label: dugong
rows.hook: is a gentle grazer of seagrass, thought to have inspired old tales of mermaids

rows.label: beluga whale
rows.hook: is a pure white Arctic cetacean nicknamed the 'canary of the sea' for its chirps and clicks

rows.label: sea lion
rows.hook: is an eared, noisy marine animal that barks and is a star of aquarium shows

rows.label: Coconut crab
rows.hook: is the largest land-living arthropod, able to climb palm trees and crack open its namesake fruit

rows.label: oyster
rows.hook: is a bivalve served on the half shell, and sometimes hides a pearl

rows.label: porpoise
rows.description: small cetacean of the family Phocoenidae
rows.hook: is a small, shy cousin of the dolphin with a blunt face and no beak

rows.label: fin whale
rows.description: baleen whale, and second-largest mammal species
rows.hook: is the second-largest animal ever known, a sleek and very fast baleen giant

rows.label: Japanese spider crab
rows.hook: has the longest leg span of any arthropod, reaching several metres from claw to claw

rows.label: southern elephant seal
rows.hook: is the largest of its kind, with males sporting a huge inflatable snout and fighting on beaches

rows.label: Lion's Mane Jellyfish
rows.hook: has the longest tentacles of any known animal, trailing like a huge stinging tangle

rows.label: North Pacific giant octopus
rows.hook: is the largest of its eight-armed kind, a cold-water record-holder and famous escape artist

rows.label: leatherback sea turtle
rows.hook: is the largest of its group, diving deep and crossing whole oceans with a soft ridged shell

rows.label: shortfin mako shark
rows.hook: is the fastest of its kind, a speedy hunter that leaps high out of the water

rows.label: goblin shark
rows.hook: has a long flat snout and jaws that shoot forward out of its pale pink head

rows.label: California sea lion
rows.hook: is the barking performer of circuses and aquariums, often seen lounging on piers

rows.label: nurse shark
rows.hook: is a docile bottom-dweller that rests in groups on the sea floor and sucks up its prey

rows.label: loggerhead sea turtle
rows.hook: is a reptile of the ocean named for its big head, and famed for nesting on beaches at night
